decisions.reason: The enclosed laser marking workstation builds on the firm's existing marking and coding expertise, so it can read early results and refine the product. Its brief mention on the website suggests it is a supporting product, not a core one, which carries some risk of being dropped.

The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer sits squarely in the firm's core coding and printing knowledge base and has a page of its own. That lets the firm absorb market feedback and improve the printer through its own R&D.

The piezo inkjet printer complements the thermal line using related printhead and ink know-how and has a page of its own. The firm should be able to assimilate what it learns and develop the product commercially.
